note: Curated few-shot exemplars from v3 3-shot smoke (highest composite=4.25 each). Two stylistically opposite high-quality concepts chosen to demonstrate range without anchoring the model on one aesthetic.
source_brief: Give me a creative logo for an engineering club at Stanford.
exemplars:
8-bit Gearheads
A retro arcade cabinet housing vintage mechanical components and glowing LED lights, featuring an oversized red button labeled "Engineer Here" with neon overlays, surrounded by schematics and circuit boards displayed on glass panels. The background showcases a vibrant pixelated grid representing computational algorithms and binary codes. In the center of the scene, a group of tech-savvy individuals wearing classic engineer's uniforms, each holding a miniature model of an intricate mechanical device, engaging in spirited discussions about innovation and problem-solving. The arcade cabinet is illuminated by a warm, nostalgic glow casting shadows that mimic old arcade machines, creating a sense of time travel through technology.

24V Power Surge
A sleek, futuristic robot with glowing red circuits surging through its body, standing atop a power outlet symbol. Its metallic surface reflects the electric current, casting dynamic shadows across a digital clock face displaying the time in binary numbers. The robot's arms are open, ready to grasp an extension cord as if about to connect to the outlet, creating a dynamic interplay of light and shadow highlighting the intricate wiring and glowing components. Surrounding the scene is a holographic representation of electrical waves emanating from the outlet, swirling and intersecting with the robot's circuits. In the background, neon green wires snake towards the ceiling, symbolizing the vast network of interconnected circuits supporting the entire campus.
